map.4-7-8呼吸法、箱式呼吸、平静呼吸，缓解焦虑、帮助入睡: 4-7-8 breathing, box breathing and calm breathing to relieve anxiety and help you fall asleep

map.单周期(s) = 吸气 + 屏气 + 呼气 (+ 呼气后屏息): Single cycle (s) = inhale + hold + exhale (+ hold after exhale)
map.总时长 = 单周期 × 目标周期数（4-7-8 法：吸 4s、屏 7s、呼 8s: Total duration = single cycle x target cycles (4-7-8 method: inhale 4s, hold 7s, exhale 8s)
map.由安德鲁·韦尔博士推广的放松呼吸法：: A relaxation breathing method popularized by Dr. Andrew Weil:
map.有助于缓解焦虑、帮助入睡、降低血压。每天练习2次，每次4个循环。: Helps relieve anxiety, fall asleep and lower blood pressure. Practice twice a day, 4 cycles each time.
map.找一个安静舒适的地方坐下或躺下: Find a quiet, comfortable place to sit or lie down
map.用鼻子吸气，用嘴巴呼气（呼气时可以发出\"呼\"的声音）: Breathe in through the nose and out through the mouth (you may make a 'whoosh' sound on exhale)
map.保持舌尖轻触上颚（门牙后方）: Keep the tongue tip lightly touching the roof of the mouth (behind the front teeth)
map.不要勉强，感觉不适时立即停止: Do not force it; stop immediately if you feel uncomfortable
map.睡前用 4-7-8 呼吸法引导放松，降低交感兴奋帮助入睡。: Use 4-7-8 breathing before sleep to induce relaxation and lower sympathetic arousal to help you fall asleep.
map.焦虑发作或公开演讲前用箱式(4-4-4-4)呼吸稳定心率与注意力。: Use box breathing (4-4-4-4) before an anxiety attack or public speech to steady heart rate and attention.
map.冥想/正念练习按设定节奏循环，量化每次练习的总时长。: Cycle meditation/mindfulness practice at a set pace and quantify the total duration of each session.
map.模式：4-7-8 呼吸法（吸气 4 秒 → 屏息 7 秒 → 呼气 8 秒），目:
Mode: 4-7-8 breathing (inhale 4s -> hold 7s -> exhale 8s), target cycles 5.
Single cycle = 4 + 7 + 8 = 19 s; 5 rounds total = 5 x 19 = 95 s ~ 1 min 35 s.
Box breathing (4-4-4-4) single cycle 16 s, 5 rounds = 80 s; calm breathing (5-5) single cycle 10 s, 5 rounds = 50 s.
Conclusion: 4-7-8 x 5 rounds is about 95 s, suitable as one pre-sleep routine.
map.延长呼气与屏息可激活副交感神经、降低心率与皮质醇，由 Andrew Weil 推: Prolonged exhale and hold activate the parasympathetic nervous system and lower heart rate and cortisol; popularized by Andrew Weil. It is a relaxation technique, not a treatment; severe insomnia needs medical investigation.
map.屏息时间太长做不了怎么办？: What if I cannot hold my breath that long?
map.可改用箱式(4-4-4-4)或平静呼吸(5-5)，或自定义缩短屏息。重点是节律稳: Switch to box breathing (4-4-4-4) or calm breathing (5-5), or customize to shorten the hold. The key is a steady rhythm, not duration; beginners should start with short durations and few cycles to avoid breath-holding discomfort.
